params.label: Image to register
params.tip: Which image version to register — usually the stack-aligned or drift-corrected one

params.label: Reference channel
params.tip: Channel used to estimate the per-pixel flow — use the brightest structured channel

params.label: Reference frame
params.tip: 'previous' rolls each frame to t-1; 'first' pins every frame to t=0

params.label: Aggressiveness
params.tip: Farneback averaging window — larger = smoother field, softer fine detail. Strong picked as default on the c91ICQ sweep — smaller windows leave more residual morphing

params.label: Pyramid levels
params.tip: More levels handle larger displacements — 5 is a safe default for typical intravital drift

params.label: Max per-pixel shift (px)
params.tip: Per-pixel flow clamp — pixels above this fall back to source, guards against wild flow
